question: Can two additive unconstrained Euclidean 256x2 codebooks remove the direction ceiling of the rejected conditional-polar two-byte carry while retaining one byte per weight of compact temporal state and acceptable training efficiency?

causal_parent.reason: The live residual distortion was distributed rather than a Lloyd, occupancy, angular-only, radial-only, center, or tail defect. All 256 conditional-polar states still occupy only 16 directions, so the successor must free the directions without increasing per-weight temporal bytes.

representation.codebooks: two layer-private free 256x2 Euclidean FP32 tables per matrix
representation.codes: two uint8 codes per weight pair
representation.training_fit: deterministic covariance-matched exact initialization; thereafter 2x2 covariance transport, local search over 16 nearest prior-code neighbors, and two scatter-mean centroid updates per stage
representation.probe_only_counterfactual: exact same-codebook residual-stage assignment at optimizer steps 0 and 8

exact_schedule.scientific_parent: same 124M QK-only attention plus compact full-MLP parent
exact_schedule.reason: Only the compact temporal representation may change in the causal gate.

aggregation.residual_stage_recovery: feedback-residual-target-energy weighted across all 24 matrices at each probe, with every-matrix minimum also enforced
aggregation.full_feedback_recovery: feedback-target-energy weighted across all 24 matrices at each probe
aggregation.local_search_regret: feedback-target-energy weighted exact-same-codebook full recovery minus local full recovery
aggregation.conservation: current-request-energy weighted across all 24 matrices at each probe, with every-matrix minimum also enforced
aggregation.occupancy_and_entropy: minimum over both stages, all matrices, and both probe steps

decision_policy.all_gates_pass: Authorize only a 238-update exact-schedule late-decay direction gate for this same representation. Do not authorize an LM endpoint, model-size scale-up, bit-rate sweep, or learning-rate sweep yet.
decision_policy.exact_codec_passes_but_local_search_regr: Keep the two-byte free-Euclidean representation and change only the local search topology or cadence, then repeat this 9-update gate.
decision_policy.free_exact_recovery_fails: Reject two-dimensional two-stage free pair VQ and derive a higher-dimensional lattice, trellis, or product code at the same one-byte-per-weight state budget before any training endpoint.
decision_policy.performance_gate_fails: Optimize the exact same candidate implementation until MFU and optimizer-overhead gates pass; do not run the scientific gate.

execution_policy.preflight: exact-config foreground real-training preflight with at least 20% MFU and at most 30% optimizer time
execution_policy.scientific_run: foreground-polled because nine updates are expected to finish within five minutes; attach a persistent @Codex watchdog immediately only if observed runtime exceeds five minutes
execution_policy.callbacks: none expected for a sub-five-minute diagnostic
